slides.title: TastePolicy
slides.body:
Subjective Authority Infrastructure
for AI Agents
slides.caption: Your taste. Your rules. Any agent.
slides.notes: Independent founder project. Evidence and assumptions as of 2026-10-28. No investor or financing commitment is implied.

slides.title: The preference boundary
slides.body:
An agent can remember what you like
and still choose beyond your rules.
slides.caption: A recommendation needs context, a permitted action ceiling and a way to pause.
slides.notes: Buyer hypothesis: travel/concierge agent teams that already propose places. IAM/tool permission and preference authority answer different questions.

slides.title: Why now
slides.body:
Conversational apps create a distribution path
for user-controlled authority.
slides.caption: MCP apps and public directories exist. Agent adoption remains early.
slides.notes: Sources: https://openai.com/index/introducing-apps-in-chatgpt/ and https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes. https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-index/2026-ai-index-report/economy reports 88% organizational AI use but agent deployment in single digits across nearly all business functions. Platform availability is not TastePolicy adoption.

slides.title: Qloo and TastePolicy
slides.body:
Qloo supplies cultural evidence.
TastePolicy applies explicit user boundaries.
slides.caption: ALLOW   ASK   REJECT   UNAVAILABLE
slides.notes: Qloo affinity is not authorization. Qloo owns the cultural graph. Written commercial/output rights and pricing are pending the official sales inquiry. See docs/company/qloo-commercial-and-data.md.

slides.title: Product and developer path
slides.body:
Reviewed taste → private Passport → credential
→ decision → receipt → bounded lease/proof
slides.caption: REST, remote MCP and A2A share the authority services.
slides.notes: Current production evidence proves fresh enrollment, SDK/A2A, export and deletion. New guided onboarding is in release verification. Organization/project/environment and billing paths remain unfinished. Verification is not authorization. Payment/booking/legal authority stays separate.

slides.title: Evaluation has exposed gaps
slides.caption: Ten operator-asserted people. 180 repeated judgments.
slides.notes: Source docs/evaluation/wg-c-human-pilot-report.md. Unsafe autonomy14/150, incorrect REJECT2/10, UNAVAILABLE agreement9/32.20/180 unscorable. These are synthetic-scenario judgments, not execution harms. No population safety or competitive-win claim. Current TasteBench24engineering cases do not establish a moat.

slides.title: First buyer and test price
slides.body:
Travel and concierge agent teams
One candidate flow before separate execution
slides.caption: Free developer usage. Pro USD49/month is an experiment.
slides.notes: Sources: https://www.cerbos.dev/pricing developer25/month production933/month; https://www.osohq.com/pricing Growth15/user/month; https://authzed.com/pricing cloud2/hour. Units differ. Qloo commercial cost is unknown. No working checkout or paid entitlement is claimed.

slides.title: Market scenario
slides.body:
100 paying workspaces at USD49/month
would produce USD58,800 annualized revenue.
slides.caption: Target, not traction. Jobs-to-team model remains unvalidated.
slides.notes: Source BLS https://www.bls.gov/ooh/computer-and-information-technology/software-developers.htm 1693800USdeveloperjobs2024. Assume10developers/team=169380team-equivalents. At588annualworkspaceprice broadproxy99.60m, relevance10%=9.96m. Jobs are not buyer companies. No measured TAM or contracted pipeline. See market-and-economics.json.

slides.title: Route to paid adoption
slides.body:
30 days: qualified interviews and design partners
60 days: scoped pilots and first price tests
90 days: retention evidence and ten paid targets
slides.caption: 100 paid customers follows validated cohorts.
slides.notes: All targets. At20%trial-to-paid need500qualifiedtrials; at30%signup-to-trial need1667signups; at5%visitor-to-signup need33340qualifiedvisitors. No actual conversion, customer or revenue metrics claimed. No outreach sent from this package.

slides.title: Defensibility and risk
slides.body:
Inspectable authority, revocation and commitments
Useful integrations and legitimate evaluation data
slides.caption: Qloo rights, buyer demand and held-out performance remain critical.
slides.notes: Prompt/memory, Qloo recommendation, deterministic rules and operational authorization vendors are alternatives. No apples-to-apples competitive result exists. Apache source remains open. No patents, exclusive rights, compliance certifications or proprietary dataset monopoly claimed. See licensing-and-ip.md and security/operations.md.
